text:
ops-bot: [ALERT] prod.cont-batch.pool-delta: KV cache pages per pod > 14k and cont-batch queue latency skyrocketing. Rule: kv_pages_per_pod > 14000 for 1m.

marco: spotted the blip at 02:46 UTC. p95 token latency jumped to ~2.4s; several client requests hit 504s. pod logs show repeated page fetch loops and elevated disk io.

leanne: pulling configs: pool-delta was tuned for throughput last month: max_batch_tokens=12288, max_num_seqs=48. that's a dangerous combo with long-prefix traffic — it aggregates huge KV prefixes.

pat: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) reduce max_batch_tokens to 2048 and max_num_seqs to 12 on pool-delta, 2) set kv.per_pod_cap=12000, 3) enable kv.bypass_for_short_prompts= true. I can push a canary first.

marco: do canary of (1) and (2) first. avoid full restarts; apply config to agent configmap and do rolling restart with maxUnavailable=1.

pat: applying canary now to pod delta-1: `kubectl patch cm cont-batch-config -n prod --patch '{"data":{"max_batch_tokens":"2048","max_num_seqs":"12","kv.per_pod_cap":"12000"}}'`

ops-bot: canary: delta-1 metrics: kv pages growth halted, swap drop, p95 latency down ~30% on canary.

leanne: good. schedule rolling update across pool-delta using: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/cont-batch-agent -n prod --selector=pool=delta --max-unavailable=1`

marco: rolling now. also flip on quick runtime guard: `kv.page_eviction_enabled=true` and `kv.eviction_threshold=0.75` to force eviction earlier.

pat: guard toggled via helm: `helm upgrade cont-batch -n prod --reuse-values --set kv.evictionThreshold=0.75 --set kv.pageBypassShortPrompts=true`

cs-bot: affected customers preliminary: StratifiedHealth (~0.9% errors), ByteCart (~0.3%). window: 02:44-02:58 UTC. CS alerted for targeted outreach.

leanne: note — we saw a perf cliff for one large enterprise model variant after the canary because we reduced batch to avoid paging; that variant was pinned to older quantized kernels and saw slower per-token throughput. monitoring closely.

marco: oncall escalation: paging @sre-rotation at 02:50 UTC. severity SEV2. handover planned at 03:05 UTC.

oncall-bot: reminder: marco -> leanne handoff at 03:05 UTC. please claim.

pat: created hotfix PR that adds two safeguards: `kv.global_page_cap=15000` and a per-request short-circuit when prompt_length < 64 tokens. also added metric `kv.pages_blocked_by_cap` for visibility. PR link: (internal).

leanne: promoting hotfix canary to two nodes first. command: `helm upgrade cont-batch -n prod --set kv.globalPageCap=15000 --set kv.bypassShortPromptTokens=64 --wait --timeout 4m`

ops-bot: canary looks stable. pages per pod down, mem pressure easing. starting progressive rollout.

marco: telemetry after full pool-delta rollout: p95 token latency reduced ~45% cluster-wide, error rate back to baseline. however observed small spike in request tail latency for variant-v2 for ~3m where requests fell back to smaller context. noted in blameless RCA.

pat: follow-ups we should track: 1) change infra defaults to conservative values (max_batch_tokens=2048, max_num_seqs=12) in prod-config repo, 2) add canary gating that blocks cont-batching changes unless a 5m canary passes, 3) add alert for `kv.pages_growth_rate > 150%/5m`.

cs-bot: customer comms: two brief messages sent to affected customers with apology and mitigation summary. requesting any observed regressions reported back.

marco: repro snippet for infra/qa to simulate long-prefix KV pressure in staging:
```
# long-prefix-stress.sh
PREFIX=$(printf 'x%.0s' {1..5000})
for i in $(seq 1 1500); do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood-inference/v1/generate \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"prompt":"'$PREFIX'","max_tokens":16}' &
done
```
Notes: this floods cont-batch with many long-prefix requests and reproduces page growth.

leanne: runbook update: add step to check pool-config for high max_batch_tokens + max_num_seqs combos before approving change. add a defensive test that runs the staging stress script during canary. owner: pat.

marco: handoff to leanne complete at 03:05 UTC. leaving monitoring for next 30m.

oncall-bot: handover accepted. leanne is now primary.

pat: added dashboard tile for `kv.pages_blocked_by_cap` and `kv.page_eviction_rate`. also added tracing label `contbatch.reconfigured` for correlating requests during rollouts.

marco: creating postmortem doc in the postmortems repo; preliminary root cause: aggressive batching defaults + long-context traffic + delayed eviction allowed a paging storm; fix: conservative defaults, per-pod caps, eviction threshold, canary gating.

ops-bot: ALERT CLEARED: kv_pages_per_pod back under threshold across pool-delta at 02:58 UTC.

leanne: thanks everyone. will keep thread open for 1h. please add any follow-up tasks to the incident board. :thumbsup:
